verdict.rationale: Greptile supports some bulk-like operations — 'Fix All' sends every review issue at once to an agent, and it reviews every PR automatically and can iterate until all comments are resolved — but this is scoped per-PR, not a general bulk operation across many repos/PRs/issues at once. There's no evidence of a bulk API endpoint, batch CLI command, or cross-repo mass-action capability. missing for 10: evidence of bulk actions spanning many PRs/repos simultaneously, a documented batch/bulk API or CLI flag, and independent confirmation that Fix All works reliably at scale.
